bullets.text: Minister Kumar opened completed projects worth Rs 1.08 crore, including a modern 70-bed health center in Adyar.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss warned of corruption in the Pallikaranai marshland project and alleged a conspiracy to usurp it.
In Tiruvallur, a 15-year-old girl faced sexual harassment, leading to the arrest of her mother and an accomplice in Avadi.
Stalled onions meant for cooperative stores rotted in a lorry near Sengundram in Tiruvallur as drivers lacked food and water.
Sudden heavy rainfall brought joy to residents across Chennai and its suburbs.
Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix the train-platform gap at the newly built Adambakkam station.
The Home Secretary transferred four police officials, appointing Eswaran as the Pallikaranai Deputy Commissioner.
BSNL is preparing to launch phase IX.2 4G services shortly in Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram, and Chengalpattu districts.
Farmers in Ponneri petitioned the chief minister's special cell after substandard weedicides damaged their paddy crops.
Avadi and Tambaram City Police destroyed over 1.7 tonnes of seized ganja, narcotic tablets, and other drug products.
The Tamil Nadu government signed an MoU with ELCOT and IITM Pravartak at the Secretariat to build a dedicated AI data center.
MeitY approved 12 projects under the electronics component manufacturing scheme with an estimated investment of Rs 7,503 crore.
The University of Madras syndicate approved an MoU with Sutherland Global Services to establish an artificial intelligence lab.
A controversy erupted over the supply of about 1,800 dubious books at inflated prices to the Periyar Arivulagam library.
TVK's IT wing questioned the DMK over alleged irregularities and fake authors involved in supplying books to the Periyar library.
Kerala Law Academy invited paper submissions for its 33rd international seminar on good governance and artificial intelligence.
